tasks.short: Study food structure, composition, and changes during storage and processing.

steps.what: Select food study methods and retrieve relevant experimental protocols
Study food structure and composition through storage and processing experiments
Record food sample measurements and experimental conditions in the laboratory notebook
Calculate food composition summaries and storage change plots
Interpret observed food changes and distinguish experimental limitations
Write conclusions about food structure, composition, and storage effects

tasks.design: Configure a laboratory notebook template in {DOCS} and reusable calculations and plots in {SPREADSHEET}. The scientist records measurements, examines the outputs, and writes the scientific conclusions; {OTHER} denotes laboratory analytical instruments.
tasks.previous_blocker: Scientists may rebuild the same summary calculations for successive storage trials.
tasks.enabler_now: Native table formulas and chart templates can repeat defined calculations on verified experimental data.
tasks.still_hard: Food changes and experimental artefacts require scientific interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist recognises when measurements do not support the apparent mechanism.
tasks.altitude: Spend less time rebuilding descriptive summaries while retaining experimental and interpretive work.

reach.learn: Which sample handling details affect interpretation

evidence.claim: SciSure provides laboratory notebooks, sample tracking, and workflows; this supports structured laboratory records, not automated scientific interpretation.
Native spreadsheet calculations can generate repeated descriptive summaries from verified trial records.

assumptions: The task includes protocol lookup, physical study, measurement recording, summaries, interpretation, and conclusion writing.

The food scientist produces s3's sample identifier, treatment, storage duration, replicate, measurement value, unit, instrument identifier, calibration reference, and missing-value reason; all capture and checking time remains within its 15% share.
The scientist selects summary definitions in s1, including grouping, units, and permitted missing values; the initial configuration is covered by build days and ongoing changes by upkeep.
S4 generates internal descriptive outputs only, not pass decisions or alerts. Missing fields, incompatible units, or unvalidated calculations require manual analysis with no saving.
Test native notebook forms and spreadsheet templates before custom code. Existing instrument runtime and same-system saves receive no labour saving; conclusion writing remains full time.
unknowns: Whether summary calculations are already configured
research_questions: Can native templates reproduce three prior trial summaries while reducing total preparation and checking time?

incremental.description: Maintain formulas and verify template changes on reference trials

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 repeated-trial scenario: B=100, R=20+40+15+0+10+5=90; gross 10%, less 4 upkeep gives central net 6%. Conservative 0-3%; already configured calculations yield no new saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer with specialists to resolve food product development problems.

steps.what: Review product development evidence before conferring with technical specialists
Confer with engineers, operators, flavor experts, and packaging and marketing specialists
Record the product development explanation and agreed specialist actions

tasks.design: Use a native issue template in {PROJECT}, linked to existing trial evidence in {DOCS}. Specialists retain the substantive discussion; the scientist records the explanation, action owner, and next trial once in the shared issue record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Unstructured notes can require repeated formatting and leave action details scattered.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing issue forms can reuse problem and trial identifiers and provide a consistent action section.
tasks.still_hard: Specialists must reconcile production, sensory, packaging, and commercial constraints.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist connects competing technical explanations and negotiates a practical next test.
tasks.altitude: Keep discussion quality while making its outcome easier to retrieve.

reach.task: Explain production constraints behind a trial failure
reach.learn: Which changes are feasible on the existing process

evidence.claim: A native issue template can reduce repeated note formatting without replacing specialist problem solving.

assumptions: The record produced by the discussion is included explicitly in s3 rather than excluded from this task.
The food scientist enters problem identifier, evidence links, agreed explanation, action owner, and next trial in s3; its 80% remaining time includes all substantive capture.
Native views in s1 touch evidence lookup but receive no saving because substantive review remains. The s3 template touches formatting and field organisation only.
No automatic send, task notification, or separate approval is proposed. Same-system saving has negligible effort and receives no saving credit.
If the issue form cannot represent the discussion, use manual notes; the small saving disappears.
unknowns: Whether a shared issue template already exists
How much current note work is formatting
research_questions: Does the native issue form save note preparation time after full action capture?

incremental.description: Maintain the issue template and field guidance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 note-formatting scenario: B=100, R=10+75+12=97; gross 3%, less 1 upkeep gives net 2%. Conservative 0-1%.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop new food items using consumer feedback and production trials.

steps.what: Retrieve consumer feedback and relevant product constraints
Interpret consumer feedback and formulate a new food item
Trial the new food item for sensory and production feasibility
Write the food item development specification and supporting trial record

loop.purpose: Draft the internal development specification from scientist selected evidence
loop.input: Revised formulation, trial observations, and development rationale
loop.output: Draft specification with traceable trial statements
loop.check: Scientist compares quantities and process statements to the trial record and checks that sensory conclusions preserve limitations
loop.stop: One revision; unresolved or unsupported sections are written manually
loop.why_not_simpler: A native template supplies fields but cannot turn free text trial observations into accurate development prose

tasks.design: Keep feedback interpretation, formulation, and trials with the scientist, using {OTHER} pilot food preparation equipment. A native {DOCS} specification template with bounded drafting support assembles an internal development record from the scientist's evidence.
tasks.previous_blocker: Trial results and formulation changes must be rewritten into a coherent development specification.
tasks.enabler_now: A source restricted assistant can draft explanatory sections while native templates preserve required fields.
tasks.still_hard: Consumer preference does not establish product safety, feasibility, or commercial suitability.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist converts feedback into testable food concepts and evaluates real trials.
tasks.altitude: Reduce specification prose assembly while retaining ownership of the food concept.

reach.learn: Which formulation details must be explicit for reproducibility

evidence.claim: Benchling can draft laboratory notebook entries and study reports; this supports a drafting capability, not validated food formulation.
Bounded drafting could reduce internal specification prose preparation after scientific checking.

assumptions: This task includes feedback lookup, concept development, physical trials, and specification writing; it does not assert commercial release.

The food scientist produces ingredient identifiers and quantities, trial date, process settings, observation text, evidence locator, and unresolved limitations during s3 and s4; all capture and checking remains in those steps, including s4's nine retained hours.
Native document templates are tested first; s1's native view does not reduce substantive feedback reading.
The assistant cannot infer missing quantities, safety status, or trial success; incomplete evidence returns to manual drafting.
No automatic send or production commit is named or proposed. The internal author save carries no self-approval gate and no separate saving.
unknowns: Whether existing specification templates already eliminate prose assembly
Which trial records are available to a drafting tool
research_questions: Does drafting reduce specification time after checking every ingredient quantity and trial claim?

already_counted.description: Trial record capture, specification checking, and completion

incremental.description: Maintain specification prompts and review recurrent drafting errors

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 specification scenario: B=100, R=15+35+35+9=94; gross 6%, less 3 upkeep gives central net 3%; conservative 0-1%.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop improved food preservation, processing, packaging, storage, and delivery methods.

steps.what: Review scientific evidence for preserving, processing, packaging, storing, and delivering foods
Develop a food handling method using chemistry and microbiology knowledge
Trial the developed food method and assess scientific limitations
Document the improved food method and its supporting trial evidence

loop.purpose: Prepare a method development record with explicit limits
loop.input: Scientist's method, trial observations, and scientific rationale
loop.output: Draft method record with evidence anchors and unresolved fields
loop.check: Scientist checks process sequence, settings, trial support, and limitations against the actual trial evidence
loop.stop: One revision; unsupported settings or claims return to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Fixed headings cannot faithfully summarise heterogeneous scientific trial observations

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} method templates and a bounded assistant to draft the development record. Scientific method selection and trials using {OTHER} pilot processing equipment remain human work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Experimental observations and method revisions require careful narrative documentation.
tasks.enabler_now: Source restricted drafting can organise supplied trial evidence without selecting the method or declaring safety.
tasks.still_hard: Scale, microbiological effects, and packaging interactions require scientific testing and interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist decides which conclusions are warranted and which further trials are needed.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repeated development prose while retaining method validity decisions.

reach.learn: Where a process change needs additional organism-specific testing

evidence.claim: Benchling drafts study reports and notebook entries, supporting scientific record drafting rather than validating food processing methods.
Checked drafting could reduce method-record preparation while leaving experimental work unchanged.

assumptions: Method evidence lookup, design, trials, and the resulting written method record are all included.

The scientist produces method revision, process sequence, temperature and duration settings, batch identifiers, trial evidence locators, and limitations; capture and checking time is retained in s4's 10.5 hours, with trial observations produced during s3.
Native document headings and reusable sections are configured before adding the assistant; substantive source appraisal in s1 remains full time.
Missing settings or unsupported safety statements require manual completion; no inferred safe/unsafe flag drives a machine.
The design creates an internal development record only, with no release, external send, or automatic equipment change. Same-system saving has no gate or saving credit.
unknowns: How much method prose is currently rewritten
Whether trial records contain enough evidence for faithful drafting
research_questions: Can the assistant draft three method records with every process claim traceable and lower total authoring time?

already_counted.description: Capture trial evidence and check the complete method record

incremental.description: Maintain method templates and review unsupported draft patterns

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 method-record scenario: B=100; R=20+25+40+10.5=95.5; gross 4.5%, less 2 upkeep gives central net 2.5%; conservative 0-1%.

role.altitude: Keep scientific food development and trial judgement while simplifying repeated data summaries and record writing.
reach: Learn production constraints from process engineers
role.ambitious_version: A food scientist whose development evidence is easier to reproduce and whose records preserve the limits of real trials.
